text: Magic scrolls are crafted by inscribing spells upon the parchment, infused with a portion of the caster's own magical essence.
zh: 魔法卷轴的制作方式，是将法术铭刻于羊皮纸上，并注入施法者自身的一部分魔法精华。

text: This allows any individual to invoke the spell, bypassing the need for formal magical study.
zh: 如此一来，任何人都能施放卷轴上的法术，而无需接受正规的魔法研习。

text: During the era of the Necromancer Wars, scrolls powered not by the scribe's energy, but the life force of victims were forged.
zh: 在死灵法师战争的年代，有人锻造出另一类卷轴——其力量并非来自书写者的能量，而是来自牺牲者的生命之力。

text: This sacrilege was banned, for they led to widespread death and suffering.
zh: 这种亵渎之举已被明令禁止，因为它们曾带来大范围的死亡与苦难。

text: The Scroll of Binding is capable of tethering the soul of its wielder to another. Once bound, their fates become irrevocably entwined.
zh: 束缚卷轴能将持有者的灵魂与另一人相系。一旦缔结，两者的命运便再也无法分离。

text: Only one recorded instance of its use exists. The necromancer Garthmir linked his soul to King Horun, ultimately forcing the king to obey his will.
zh: 有记载的使用案例仅有一例。死灵法师加斯米尔将自己的灵魂与霍伦国王相连，最终迫使国王听命于他。

text: When Garthmir prepared to sacrifice the people of Lirith, the king commanded his own guard to strike him down. The blow ended Garthmir's life, severing the bond.
zh: 当加斯米尔准备献祭利里斯的民众时，国王命令自己的卫兵将其斩杀。这一击终结了加斯米尔的性命，也斩断了灵魂的联结。

text: The Scroll of Life was forged out of desperation.
zh: 生命卷轴诞生于绝望之中。

text: In his pursuit of immortality, the necromancer Sazzou offered the life of his beloved, using it to craft the Scroll of Life.
zh: 死灵法师萨佐为追求不朽，献出了挚爱之人的性命，以此锻造出生命卷轴。

text: This artifact enables its wielder to bind a spirit to its former vessel, mending even mortal wounds in an instant.
zh: 此神器能让持有者将灵魂重新束缚于原先的躯壳，即便是致命的创伤也能在瞬间愈合。

text: Yet if the body has decayed beyond use, resurrection becomes impossible. The soul may return, but it will linger in the mortal realm, unable to find rest.
zh: 然而，若躯体腐朽到无法使用，复活便无从谈起。灵魂或许会归来，却只能徘徊于凡世，永不得安息。
